description: Entry validation (#1376): actions, max_depth, allowed_delegates, time_window, recipient_domain and resource form

cases.description: An entry whose actions array is empty

expected.reason: actions is non-empty

cases.description: An action value carrying a slash

expected.reason: the whole value matches the action grammar; a slash is outside it

cases.description: An action value with a trailing space

expected.reason: a character outside the grammar fails the value wherever it sits

cases.description: A recognized action beside a value outside the grammar

expected.reason: one malformed value refuses the entry; it is not dropped

cases.description: A family marker inside an action value

expected.reason: a family is an identifier followed by .* at the end of the value

cases.description: A bare wildcard

expected.reason: a family needs an identifier before .*

cases.description: Action identifiers using every character the grammar admits

expected.reason: letters, digits, underscore, dot, colon and hyphen are all admitted

cases.description: An action family

expected.reason: an identifier followed by .* is an action family

cases.description: A negative delegation.max_depth

expected.reason: max_depth is a non-negative integer

cases.description: A fractional delegation.max_depth

expected.reason: max_depth is a non-negative integer

cases.description: A delegation.max_depth of 0 beside a children grant

expected.reason: 0 is a valid depth; the companion-defined children member is not voided by it

cases.description: An empty allowed_delegates list

expected.reason: an empty list is well formed; it permits no delegate (ev-dlg-02)

cases.description: A time_window whose not_before is later than its not_after

expected.reason: an inverted window is refused at intake, not first at derivation

cases.description: A time_window inverted only once its offsets are applied

expected.reason: the bounds are compared as instants: 02:00+02:00 is 00:00Z, before 01:00Z

cases.description: A time_window whose bounds name the same instant

expected.reason: not_before at or before not_after; both bounds are inclusive

cases.description: A time_window whose not_after is an actual leap second

expected.reason: Common Constraint date-time values do not use 60 for the seconds field, though RFC 3339 permits an actual leap second

cases.description: A time_window whose not_before is an actual leap second in an offset form

expected.reason: Common Constraint date-time values do not use 60 for the seconds field, in any offset

cases.description: A time_window whose not_after uses :60 at no leap second

expected.reason: Common Constraint date-time values do not use 60 for the seconds field

cases.description: A time_window bounded by the instants either side of a leap second

expected.reason: ordinary timestamps, and not_before is before not_after

cases.description: A resource_issued_after that is an actual leap second

expected.reason: Common Constraint date-time values do not use 60 for the seconds field, though RFC 3339 permits an actual leap second

cases.description: A resource_issued_before that is an actual leap second in an offset form

expected.reason: Common Constraint date-time values do not use 60 for the seconds field, in any offset

cases.description: A resource_issued_after that uses :60 at no leap second

expected.reason: Common Constraint date-time values do not use 60 for the seconds field

cases.description: A resource_issued_before that is an ordinary timestamp beside a leap second

expected.reason: an ordinary timestamp in an offset form

cases.description: A recipient_domain with a trailing dot

expected.reason: a recipient_domain carries no trailing dot

cases.description: A recipient_domain with a non-ASCII label

expected.reason: an internationalized label appears in its A-label form

cases.description: A recipient_domain in A-label form, in mixed case

expected.reason: ASCII labels in any letter case; values compare case-insensitively

cases.description: A recipient_domain whose xn-- label does not decode under Punycode (a truncated integer)

expected.reason: an internationalized label is an A-label (RFC 5890 Section 2.3.2.1); xn--9 decodes to nothing

cases.description: A recipient_domain whose xn-- label decodes past U+10FFFF

expected.reason: an internationalized label is an A-label (RFC 5890 Section 2.3.2.1); xn--rf96i decodes to code point 1415195

cases.description: A recipient_domain whose xn-- label decodes to a form not in lower case (mÜnchen)

expected.reason: an internationalized label is an A-label (RFC 5890 Section 2.3.2.1); the decoded form is checked as decoded, never case-folded

cases.description: A recipient_domain whose xn-- label decodes to a form not in NFC (me, U+0301, nchen)

expected.reason: an internationalized label is an A-label (RFC 5890 Section 2.3.2.1); the decoded form is checked as decoded, never normalized

cases.description: A recipient_domain whose xn-- label decodes to a form beginning with a combining mark (U+0301, mnchen)

expected.reason: an internationalized label is an A-label (RFC 5890 Section 2.3.2.1); a U-label does not begin with a combining mark (RFC 5891 Section 4.2.3.2)

cases.description: A recipient_domain whose xn-- label decodes to a form beginning with a hyphen (-münchen)

expected.reason: an internationalized label is an A-label (RFC 5890 Section 2.3.2.1); a U-label does not begin or end with a hyphen (RFC 5891 Section 4.2.3.1)

cases.description: A recipient_domain whose xn-- label decodes to a form with hyphens in its third and fourth positions (mü--nchen)

expected.reason: an internationalized label is an A-label (RFC 5890 Section 2.3.2.1); a U-label has no hyphens in its third and fourth positions (RFC 5891 Section 4.2.3.1)

cases.description: A recipient_domain whose A-label (münchen) is in upper case throughout

expected.reason: the ASCII A-label compares case-insensitively, so it is read in lower case before decoding

cases.description: An exact entry whose resource carries a fragment

expected.reason: every resource is an RFC 3986 absolute-URI, which has no fragment

cases.description: An https resource with an empty host

expected.reason: an http or https resource names a non-empty host

cases.description: An https resource without the // authority form

expected.reason: an http or https resource takes the // authority form

cases.description: An exact entry whose resource carries a query

expected.reason: absolute-URI admits a query; only a prefix entry refuses one

cases.description: An https resource carrying a user name

expected.reason: an http or https resource carries no userinfo subcomponent (RFC 9110 Section 4.2.4)

cases.description: An https resource carrying a user name and password

expected.reason: an http or https resource carries no userinfo subcomponent (RFC 9110 Section 4.2.4)

cases.description: An https resource carrying an empty userinfo

expected.reason: an empty userinfo is still a userinfo subcomponent: the authority holds an @

cases.description: An http resource carrying userinfo, its scheme in upper case

expected.reason: the scheme is case-insensitive (RFC 3986 Section 3.1), so the value is an http URI carrying userinfo

cases.description: An https resource with an @ in its path

expected.reason: an @ after the authority is path data, not userinfo

cases.description: An empty allowed_delegates list; the delegation policy permits the delegate

expected.reason: an empty list permits no delegate; it does not defer to policy

cases.description: An absent allowed_delegates list; the delegation policy permits the delegate

expected.reason: an absent list defers to policy, the counterpart of ev-dlg-02

cases.description: max_depth 0; the list names the delegate, at delegation depth 1

expected.reason: every delegated token has depth 1 or more, so depth 0 supplies no in-Mission delegated authority

cases.description: max_depth 0 with a children grant, in the ceiling and the proposal

expected.reason: depth 0 leaves the independently bounded children grant intact

cases.description: An entry carries an action the resource does not define beside one it does

expected.reason: an unrecognized action grants nothing and leaves the rest of the entry enforceable

cases.description: A max_amount amount given as a JSON number

expected.reason: a decimal value outside the grammar is malformed and refused at submission, never parsed

cases.description: A max_amount amount in scientific notation

expected.reason: a decimal value outside the grammar is malformed and refused at submission, never parsed

cases.description: A max_amount amount with a sign

expected.reason: a decimal value outside the grammar is malformed and refused at submission, never parsed

cases.description: A max_amount amount with a thousands separator

expected.reason: a decimal value outside the grammar is malformed and refused at submission, never parsed

cases.description: A max_amount amount that is a non-numeric token

expected.reason: a decimal value outside the grammar is malformed and refused at submission, never parsed

cases.description: A max_amount amount with 19 fractional digits

expected.reason: a decimal value outside the grammar is malformed and refused at submission, never parsed

cases.description: A max_amount amount ending in a decimal point

expected.reason: a decimal value outside the grammar is malformed and refused at submission, never parsed

cases.description: A max_amount amount with no integer digit

expected.reason: a decimal value outside the grammar is malformed and refused at submission, never parsed

cases.description: A max_amount amount with 18 fractional digits

expected.reason: the grammar admits one to 18 fractional digits

cases.description: A max_amount amount of zero

expected.reason: one or more decimal digits with no fraction is in the grammar

cases.description: A top-level member no specification defines for this type

expected.reason: a member the comparison cannot decide is unsupported input, refused rather than dropped

cases.description: An action family on a consumer that does not implement action families

expected.reason: an action family is unsupported input where the family clauses are not implemented (D684)

cases.description: A max_amount currency in lower case

expected.reason: not exactly three upper-case ASCII letters, so malformed and refused at submission; never case-folded

cases.description: A max_amount currency in mixed case

expected.reason: not exactly three upper-case ASCII letters, so malformed and refused at submission; never case-folded

cases.description: A max_amount currency of two letters

expected.reason: not exactly three upper-case ASCII letters, so malformed and refused at submission

cases.description: A max_amount currency of four letters

expected.reason: not exactly three upper-case ASCII letters, so malformed and refused at submission

cases.description: A max_amount currency given as the numeric code

expected.reason: not exactly three upper-case ASCII letters, so malformed and refused at submission; no numeric code

cases.description: A max_amount currency ending in a line terminator

expected.reason: not exactly three upper-case ASCII letters, so malformed and refused at submission; the length is four

cases.description: A max_amount currency with a leading space

expected.reason: not exactly three upper-case ASCII letters, so malformed and refused at submission; never trimmed

cases.description: A max_amount currency with a non-ASCII letter

expected.reason: not exactly three upper-case ASCII letters, so malformed and refused at submission

cases.description: An empty max_amount currency

expected.reason: not exactly three upper-case ASCII letters, so malformed and refused at submission

cases.description: A max_amount currency given as a JSON number

expected.reason: a currency is a string of three upper-case ASCII letters

cases.description: A well-formed max_amount currency ISO 4217 does not assign

expected.reason: a well-formed code is admitted for structural validation and comparison whether or not ISO 4217 assigns it

cases.description: An entry without a type

expected.reason: every authorization details object names its type, so an entry without one is refused at intake

cases.description: An entry whose type is not a string

expected.reason: a type is a string naming an authorization details type; any other value is refused at intake

cases.description: A max_amount carrying a member beside amount and currency

expected.reason: the amount object has exactly the members amount and currency; any other member is malformed input, never ignored, refused at submission

cases.description: An entry on the payments resource referencing the contract configuration names as current for it

expected.reason: the reference equals, member for member, the one configuration names as current for the entry's resource, and that version defines payments:invoice.read

cases.description: An entry on an unrelated resource referencing the payments contract

expected.reason: configuration names the payments contract current for https://payments.example/mcp only; no contract is current for this resource

cases.description: An entry on the payments resource referencing a version configuration does not name as current

expected.reason: the reference is not the version configuration names as current for the entry's resource

cases.description: An entry referencing the payments contract with no configuration naming any contract current

expected.reason: an absent contracts names no contract current for any resource

cases.description: An entry on the payments resource referencing the version the v15 configuration names as current for it (2026-10-26)

expected.reason: the reference equals, member for member, the one configuration names as current for the entry's resource, and that version defines payments:invoice.read

cases.description: An entry on an unrelated resource referencing the payments contract version the v15 configuration names as current for the payments resource

expected.reason: configuration names the payments contract current for https://payments.example/mcp only; no contract is current for this resource

cases.description: An entry on the payments resource referencing 2026-10-24, a version the v15 configuration does not name as current

expected.reason: the reference is not the version configuration names as current for the entry's resource

cases.description: An entry referencing the payments contract's 2026-10-26 version with no configuration naming any contract current

expected.reason: an absent contracts names no contract current for any resource

cases.description: An entry on the payments resource referencing the version the v16 configuration names as current for it (2026-10-27)

expected.reason: the reference equals, member for member, the one configuration names as current for the entry's resource, and that version defines payments:invoice.read

cases.description: An entry on an unrelated resource referencing the payments contract version the v16 configuration names as current for the payments resource

expected.reason: configuration names the payments contract current for https://payments.example/mcp only; no contract is current for this resource

cases.description: An entry on the payments resource referencing 2026-10-26, a version the v16 configuration does not name as current

expected.reason: the reference is not the version configuration names as current for the entry's resource

cases.description: An entry referencing the payments contract's 2026-10-27 version with no configuration naming any contract current

expected.reason: an absent contracts names no contract current for any resource
